newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech SPT begins ISDN trial July 1.
newsitem.headline: Czech SPT begins ISDN trial July 1.

text.p: Czech SPT Telecom a.s. said on Monday it would begin trial operations for providing telecommunications services through ISDN from July 1.
SPT said in a statement said it would provide connections with Switzerland from July 1 and with Germany from July 7. Connections with other countries would be provided by the end of the year.
ISDN technology is used to increase existing telephone line transmission capabilities and makes possible simultaneous voice and data transmission over a single line.
SPT said it had chosen the euroISDN system to ensure it was compatible with similar services and equipment suppliers in Europe.
ISDN services would first be available in the major Czech cities of Prague, Brno and Ostrava, SPT said.
